text:
Noah: Planning a creep-ramp for llmroute v4 using flag `llmroute_v4_creep` tomorrow 04:45 UTC. Strategy: tiny initial exposure and attenuation-friendly roll (keep ability to pin to v3 instantly). Please schedule and create ephemeral cohort `creep-001`. :satellite:

Iris: Proposed ramp: 0.1% -> 1% (hold 20m) -> 7% (hold 20m) -> 30% -> 100%. Soak windows at 1% and 7% with automated telemetry checks.

Ken: Safety gates: p95 latency delta >100ms OR error rate >0.5% OR token-cost per 1k increase >20% -> trigger mitigation. Mitigation flow: 1) auto-reduce cohort to 0.5% for 5m; 2) if still over threshold -> auto-pin to v3 and drain cohort. Notify #eng-oncall and #customer-success.

Noah: Add quick rollback snippet for ops runbook:```
# create ephemeral cohort and seed to 0.1%
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4_creep creep-001 --region prod-global
rb ff set llmroute_v4_creep --cohort creep-001 --weight 0.1
# emergency pin to stable
rb ff set llmroute_v4_creep --cohort global --weight 0
rb route set default --model llmroute-v3
# drain cohort
rb drain cohort creep-001 --timeout 120
```

Iris: Can deploy-bot capture a preflight snapshot (p50/p95, cpu, token_cost_per_1k, sample prompts) and attach it to the rollout note? We'll diff at each holdpoint.

deploy-bot: Preflight snapshot captured: p50=44ms p95=115ms cpu_avg=23% token_cost_per_1k=$0.36. Cohort creep-001 created (id: c-ff12). Rollout scheduled at 2026-01-15T04:45:00Z. Will post metrics at each holdpoint and attempt conservative reduce before full pin on threshold breach.

Ken: For automated pin labeling: use tag `rollback:automated-creep` so we can filter incidents. Also make sure the automated reduce step posts a one-line rationale and the raw metric that tripped the gate.

Noah: Release notes blurb (draft): "llmroute v4 (creep rollout) — iterative rerank improvements, rolling exposure starting globally with attenuation controls. See full notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/llmroute-v4/creep". Tagging CS to review message about expected subtle ranking shifts.

Iris: Final rule at each holdpoint: soak 20m. If any safety gate trips -> reduce to 0.5% and wait 5m; if no recovery -> pin to v3 and escalate. If all good, proceed to next step after ops ack.

Ken: I'll be on watch for the 1% and 7% holds. SRE oncall will get pings from deploy-bot.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Will monitor infra and observe tail latencies. If automated pin happens, we'll open an incident and post a short RCA stub.

Noah: Thanks team 44d. I'll paste the short runbook into #release-notes before the window and update once deploy-bot posts the holdpoint reports.
